brief.claim: From 15 clinical measurements recorded in a patient registry, a nearest-neighbour rule predicts diagnosis in new patients with accuracy of at least 0.75. Some patients were entered more than once.

data_keys.meaning: clinical measurements, one row per registry entry
True if the patient has the diagnosis

brief.sizes: 200 rows, 15 measurements; about a quarter of the rows repeat an earlier entry exactly, with its diagnosis.
